verdict.rationale: Honcho's changelog documents named-scope API keys: a key bound to one named scope and limited to recall and message ingestion, including creating new member sessions. That is a first-party least-privilege credential an agent could be given, but the evidence is a single changelog line with no detail on how keys are issued or how fine-grained permissions can be. Missing for 10: documentation of the key issuance workflow (CLI/API/dashboard), configurable permission granularity beyond recall/ingestion, revocation/rotation and expiry controls, independent or hands-on corroboration.
